subject.title: fix(release): bind npm publishing to approved package bytes

question: Do release managers approve requiring exact preflight_run_id plus preflight_run_attempt evidence for every npm publication and supported recovery path?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but it deliberately tightens a protected release security boundary and operator contract owned by the release-manager team.

options.title: Approve strict binding
options.body: Adopt the exact run-and-attempt contract and land using the successful current-head validation.

options.title: Preserve compatibility temporarily
options.body: Hold the PR and define an explicit migration window if a supported recovery flow still requires run-ID-only selection.

recommendation.title: Approve strict binding
recommendation.body: Adopt the exact run-and-attempt contract and land using the successful current-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the final exact-attempt and recovery hardening and have the strongest recent history across the central release paths.
